senses.gloss: m. (reduplic. of שׁוֹט) rod-holder, keeper of a vivarium.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5">Lev. R. s. 5</cite> <he>משל לש׳ של דוב וכ׳</he> this is like the case of the keeper of a bear that ate the bear’s rations (v. <cite ref="O00579"><he>סִידּוּר</he></cite>); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 469">Yalk. ib. 469</cite> <cite ref="U00576"><he>שושנה</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 729">Yalk. Num. 729</cite> <he>שׁוֹשָׁטוֹ</he> (not <he>שושבינו</he>) his (the lion’s) keeper.
